## Checks

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits, for example `fix(dsp): correct ROCOF sign at negative ramps`.
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and the relevant checks from CONTRIBUTING.md pass locally.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior, interfaces, or hardware change.
- [ ] No exact coordinates, WiFi credentials, or node tokens appear in code, tests, logs, or screenshots.
- [ ] Hardware changes keep voltage sensing limited to the isolated AC-AC adapter, divider, and bias network.
